placements.title: Creating a memory automatically makes its creator a reviewer
placements.theme: Saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer of that memory — a standing invariant of the review system that the e2e suite treats as behavior to keep asserting, not a one-off fact.
placements.why: src-1 states the e2e suite's assertion that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer, and src-2 frames the probe memory as existing solely to carry and re-surface that assertion. This is a design/behavior claim about the review system (creator-becomes-reviewer-on-save) that future test envelopes and product docs would keep feeding, not a one-time measurement — it passes the narrative grain test. No existing strata or narrative structure was supplied (both are empty for this repo), so nothing could be reused, and nothing existing gives this leaf a home to attach under; it stands foundational.
